- `INFO`: Most high-level module descriptions are otherwise accurate: `tt_svd.py` is a re-export in [tt_svd.py#L11](/home/xiyaofeng/huicheng/MPO_Compression/mpo_modules/optimizers/one_site/tt_svd.py#L11), `hybrid_bb.py` is ALS+BB in [hybrid_bb.py#L114](/home/xiyaofeng/huicheng/MPO_Compression/mpo_modules/optimizers/global_opt/hybrid_bb.py#L114), and the related-module pointers for `core.py`, `tt_ops.py`, `ring_ops.py`, `activation_driven/`, and `healing.py` match the source in [core.py#L40](/home/xiyaofeng/huicheng/MPO_Compression/mpo_modules/core.py#L40), [tt_ops.py#L20](/home/xiyaofeng/huicheng/MPO_Compression/mpo_modules/tt_ops.py#L20), [ring_ops.py#L24](/home/xiyaofeng/huicheng/MPO_Compression/mpo_modules/ring_ops.py#L24), [activation_driven/__init__.py#L7](/home/xiyaofeng/huicheng/MPO_Compression/mpo_modules/activation_driven/__init__.py#L7), and [healing.py#L87](/home/xiyaofeng/huicheng/MPO_Compression/healing.py#L87).
